title: Entrepreneur
description: The applicant as a person (PRD section 19). For phone sign-in the _id equals the entrepreneur's User _id, so submission scope can use the signed-in user ID; assisted and imported applicants get their own _id. Personal details are sealed in `personal` (never selected by default) and contactHashes allow duplicate matching without decrypting. Nothing here is sent to models or map services (D-13).

personal.description: Sealed JSON: name, and when collected phone, email, gender and social category (Q-23).

onboarding.description: Sealed one-time onboarding contact, background, location detail and EDP answers; never sent to models or partners.

contactHashes.description: Keyed HMAC-SHA256 of each normalised phone/email (backend/src/crypto.ts), hex.

placeholderContact.description: True when the contact is a known dummy (for example 9000000080 or @demo.com), so it is excluded from duplicate matching.

trade.description: Trade or skill as given; the normalised trade key lives on the submission.

clientApplicantId.description: Assisted mode: the facilitator device's ID for this applicant, so an offline retry does not register them twice (Dev 1).

homeOrgId.description: Centre that owns the relationship, once assigned.
